overall: Los Angeles is experiencing a classic marine layer morning with patchy fog and a flat temperature profile — current temp is 64.4°F and has shown zero warming velocity since at least 07:00 ET, consistent with overcast coastal suppression. The day is running cooler than it will likely peak, but the marine influence (SW winds, high dewpoint of 57.2°F) is keeping a lid on early warming. No tropical or severe weather concerns for the area; the NWS alerts are localized to inland lake/mountain zones and Imperial County air quality.
